activity.notes: Johan de Witt served as Grand Pensionary of Holland from 1653 to 1672 and, during the First Stadtholderless Period, exercised dominant political leadership in the Dutch Republic. The role title remains the actual provincial office rather than an invented national presidency.

sources.title: Johan de Witt, Grand Pensionary of Holland — Rijksmuseum
sources.citation_text: States that De Witt was appointed Grand Pensionary in 1653 and exercised virtual control of government during the stadtholderless period.
